Thanks Isla — this is a great start. A couple of follow-ups before we can submit to AP for master creation: 

1) Can you confirm the vendor's legal entity registration country and state? (We have CA, but need registered state for tax mapping)
2) Who is the authorized signer for contracts (name, title, email)?
3) Please confirm the remittance ACH details or let us know if you prefer credit card payments; AP needs either a voided check / formatted ACH form or the bank letter you provided (the bank letter is fine but the ACH form speeds things up).
4) Beneficial ownership: list any individuals owning >25% of the company (name + country of residence).
5) ERP vendor code preference: if you already have a vendor ID in your system you want us to map, send it along; otherwise we'll allocate one.

Also attaching our Vendor Onboarding Checklist (internal) — I'll fill in what I can and route to AP once we have the signer and ACH confirmation. Marcus, Vanessa — looping you both in for vendor code and any payment exceptions (Wavecraft requested net-30 on initial PO).

Thanks,
Tessa
